name: Bayt Al Ghaf
description: Bayt Al Ghaf is a contemporary Emirati restaurant and majlis in the Al Seef heritage quarter on the Bur Dubai side of Dubai Creek. The kitchen cooks the dishes Emirati families eat at home — machboos, harees, thareed, saloona and luqaimat — with careful sourcing, house-ground bezar and slow, unhurried cooking, and serves them in a dining room of coral-stone walls, palm-frond ceilings and creek views.

name: Car
description: From Sheikh Zayed Road, take Exit 50 towards Al Mankhool / Bur Dubai, follow Khalid Bin Al Waleed Road (Bank Street) towards Al Ghubaiba, then turn right onto Al Seef Street. From Deira, cross Al Maktoum Bridge, keep right towards Bur Dubai and follow signs for Al Seef. Our entrance faces Al Seef Street at Heritage Quarter Gate 3; a drop-off bay is directly outside the takeaway counter.

name: Taxi or ride-hailing
description: Ask for “Al Seef, Heritage Quarter, Gate 3, near Al Fahidi Historical Neighbourhood”. A taxi from Dubai International Airport (DXB) usually takes 15–25 minutes depending on traffic; from Downtown Dubai about 15–20 minutes. Ride-hailing pick-up and drop-off is at the Gate 3 lay-by on Al Seef Street.

name: Dubai Metro
description: Take the Green Line to Al Fahidi Metro Station. Use the exit towards Al Fahidi Street / Al Seef and walk north-east towards the creek for about 10 minutes, passing the Al Fahidi Historical Neighbourhood on your left. From the Red Line, change to the Green Line at BurJuman, or walk 20–25 minutes from BurJuman station.

Al Seef also has a water-taxi and ferry stop; schedules are operated by the RTA and change seasonally.
